content:
anna: Customer report: p95/p99 spike for sirocco-v3 after onboarding. Multiple customers complaining about higher tail latency on long inputs (>6k tokens). Observed p95 ~920ms (was ~260ms), p99 ~2.1s. CC @lee @devon :eyes:
lee: ack. I can see the same in dashboards — spike starts exactly at the time we pushed sirocco-v3 to hosted-prod routing policy v2 (~08:12 UTC).
devon: looking at model differences: sirocco-v3 tokenizer appears to emit ~1.7x tokens for certain inputs (emoji-heavy & repeated markup). Could be subword explosion.
anna: customer example attached in DM. They say request body is ~22k chars, expecting ~3k tokens historically, now ~5k tokens.
raj: infra view: GPU queues show sustained saturation for requests with long seqs. Batching window increased, lots of in-flight concurrency, so effective latency ballooning.
ops-bot: alert: route_utilization for sirocco-v3-hosted increased from 62% to 96% between 08:12-08:40 UTC.
lee: quick repro steps I just ran: curl to /v1/generate with model=sirocco-v3 and prompt containing repeated emoji block. Repro body:
```
POST /v1/generate
{
  "model": "sirocco-v3",
  "input": "😀😀😀... (repeat 4000 chars)",
  "max_tokens": 512,
  "stream": false
}
```
lee: On sirocco-v2 same request p95 ~260ms. On v3 p95 ~1.05s.
devon: tokenizer delta: v3 uses a multi-byte merge table to support more languages; edge-case merges create many tiny tokens for emoji sequences. That increases sequence length and KV cache pressure.
anna: also seeing some API 502s correlated with the spike — maybe timeouts in the serving runtime.
raj: logs from runtime (excerpt):
```
[2026-03-16T08:14:23Z] serve: start request id=abc123 model=sirocco-v3 seq_len=4962
[2026-03-16T08:14:23Z] kernel: select strategy=dynamic_batch window_ms=15 queued=12
[2026-03-16T08:14:24Z] kvcache: alloc failed try_compact=true
[2026-03-16T08:14:25Z] serve: request id=abc123 error=deadline_exceeded
```
devon: that kvcache alloc failed is interesting — v3's tokenization increases memory working set per request. Could push some requests to streaming slowpath.
lee: immediate mitigations we applied at 08:32 UTC:
- pinned hosted route for large_seq_policy to fallback to sirocco-v2 for inputs >4k tokens
- reduced default max_tokens for hosted quick-start from 2048 -> 1024
- lowered runtime max_batch_size for sirocco-v3 to 8 to avoid oversized batches
These reduced p95 to ~320ms within ~10m of changes. :thumbsup:
anna: customers notified of temporary fallback. One reported improved latency after change.
raj: small note: autoscaler observed a lot of tiny batches which increased per-token overhead. We can evict some low-priority queued small requests to improve SLOs.
devon: longer-term fixes:
- ML: adjust tokenizer merges to avoid subword explosion on emoji/markup (rollback specific merge file entries).
- Runtime: improve KV cache compaction and fallback to diskless streaming to avoid deadline_exceeded.
- Or provide a quantized variant with smaller activation memory: sirocco-v3-q4_0 that reduces working set by ~30%.
lee: I opened a runtime hotfix PR to add a backoff that avoids over-aggregating long-seq requests into a single batch. Linking: https://git.redwood/repo/runtime/pulls/4123
deploy-bot: deploy requested: runtime/patch-4123 -> staging at 09:05 UTC
devon: also created tokenizer PR to revert the problematic merge rules and add unit tests with repeated-emoji fixtures. PR: https://git.redwood/repo/tokenizers/pulls/89
anna: reproduction checklist for support engineers (please paste in customer threads):
1) Ask customer for raw prompt + metadata (model, max_tokens, stream setting).
2) Run local repro with same prompt against sirocco-v2 and v3: compare token counts: `python -c "from tokenizers import Tokenizer; print(len(Tokenizer.from_file('sirocco-v3.json').encode(open('prompt.txt').read())))"`
3) If token count is >1.4x vs v2, offer to route them to sirocco-v2 fallback and reduce max_tokens.
4) If 502s/timeouts observed, escalate to eng-sre with logs and request ids.

lee: followups:
- I will monitor p95/p99 for next 24h, and revert routing fallback only after runtime hotfix + tokenizer change.
- If hotfix in staging looks good, schedule roll to prod with canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%.

raj: infra action items:
- reserve extra ephemeral capacity for long-seq workloads for 12 hours to absorb bursts.
- add a metric for per-request kvcache-alloc-failures.

devon: ML items:
- reproduce token explosion tests and cut a sirocco-v3.1 with token fix; target release in 2-3 days.
- prepare quantized build artifacts for immediate fallback.

anna: I'll consolidate customer comms and update the ticket queue. Thanks team.
lee: thanks — keeping this open until postmortem. :eyes:
